titulo: Review and final exam: Review map

aula.objetivo: Review the alphabet, gender, agreement, the basic cases, the present and the past tense, and take the final exam of the beginner level.

blocos.titulo: Everything you already know, in one table
blocos.explicacao: This table sums up every grammar point from the earlier lessons in one line. Reread one line at a time and say an example of your own out loud. If a line looks strange, go back to the lesson shown or open the topic in the Grammar tab.

tabela.regra: There is no «the / a»; the context decides.
No «есть» in the present: «Это дом», «Я врач».
ты (friends) versus вы (formal or plural).
Consonant, -й, -ь: masculine; -а, -я: feminine; -о, -е, -мя: neuter.
-ы / -и / -а / -я; after г к х ж ч ш щ write -и.
They agree with the gender and number of the noun.
У меня есть + nominative; У меня нет + genitive.
«не» before the negated word; «никогда не».
1st: -ю, -ешь, -ет, -ем, -ете, -ют; 2nd: -ю, -ишь, -ит, -им, -ите, -ят; irregulars: пить, есть, мочь, спать.
в = inside, country, city; на = on top, open space, event; verbs of position.
Standing still: prepositional; movement: accusative (в школе → в школу).
Accusative: -а → -у; inanimate masculine and neuter do not change.
1 рубль, 2–4 рубля, 5+ рублей.
They never change; they come from the adjective by changing the ending to -о.
Yes/no by intonation; the question word goes first.
Six cases; each ending shows the function of the word.
в + day (в пятницу); в + hour (в пять часов).
After a vowel -сь, after a consonant -ся.
-л, -ла, -ло, -ли; был/была/было/были.
Мне нужно/нужен/нужна/нужны; можно; нельзя.

blocos.enunciado: Introduce yourself in 6 sentences, out loud: name, where you are from, job, where you live, what you like and what you did yesterday.
Read the alphabet out loud, from А to Я, without looking.
